## About
Body Work by Fischer, Inc. is a full-service auto body shop in Westfield, New Jersey, family owned and operated for decades by the Starr family. The business passed from Dave Sr. to Dave Jr., and we are here to personally help every client through their repair step by step.
Collision repair is our specialty, but we also handle refinishing, frame straightening and color matching. We're ASE certified, and we keep up with new techniques through classes and seminars. We try to fix damage rather than replace parts when that saves you money, and we keep you posted on progress so the job finishes when we said it would.
Customers rate us 4.9 from 73 Google reviews. Our goal has always been to build a strong clientele and be an asset to the community.

## Services
- Collision work: We handle collision repairs from start to finish and help get your vehicle back on the road.
- Auto body repair and refinishing: When we repair a door or other damaged part, we refinish it with quality materials so it blends with the rest of the car.
- Frame straightening: We straighten a damaged frame back to factory specifications on our frame machine.
- Color matching: We use BASF paint and a computerized color matcher to match the color and panels on your vehicle.
- On-site mechanical repairs: When a body repair calls for mechanical work too, we can take care of it here at the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: Yes. We work with your insurance company, examine the damage and give you an estimate of the repair cost.

Q: Do you work on imports as well as domestic cars?
A: Yes. We service both domestic and import models.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Give us a call at (908) 232-5305, or use the estimate request on our website.
